description: Hi everyone! I enjoy science, creativity, learning new things, and exploring fresh ideas. I value teamwork, communication, and problem-solving. I’m looking for friendly, responsible, creative, and open-minded team members who are willing to share ideas, support each other, and contribute their skills. Let’s work together, learn from one another, and achieve our goals as a team!
summary: Our project, Navigating the Void, shows how astronauts survive a trip to Mars using three NASA tools. MONTE predicts the perfect trajectory, the Deep Space Network tracks the spacecraft position, and ETPC Guidance controls the landing on Mars. Perseverance proved it works by landing only 5 meters from its target in 2021. This project helps students understand space navigation easily, inspires interest in STEM, and shows that space success is precision, not luck. We built it using Canva, CapCut and Meta AI, and we considered accuracy, safety, simplicity and low cost.
